name: α-PCYP
summary: α-PCyP (α-Pyrrolidinocyclohexanophenone) is a stimulant drug of the cathinone class that has been sold online as a designer drug.

pharmacology.text: In a series of alpha-substituted pyrrolidinyl cathinone derivatives developed in 2015, the alpha-cyclopentyl derivative was found to have around the same potency in vitro as an inhibitor of the dopamine transporter as the alpha-propyl derivative α-PVP, while the alpha-cyclohexyl derivative α-PCyP was around twice as strong.

uses.text: α-PCyP (α-Pyrrolidinocyclohexanophenone) is a stimulant drug of the cathinone class that has been sold online as a designer drug.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its family, the α-pyrrolidinophenones such as α-PVP, can cause a racing heart, raised blood pressure, overheating, insomnia, agitation, paranoia and a strong urge to keep redosing. Serious risks include psychosis, violent agitation, heart problems, seizures and dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同家族的α-吡咯烷苯酮類藥物（例如α-PVP），可能引起心跳急促、血壓升高、體溫過高、失眠、躁動、多疑，以及想一再追加用藥的強烈衝動。嚴重風險包括精神病、激烈躁動、心臟問題、癲癇發作與成癮。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同家族的α-吡咯烷苯酮类药物（例如α-PVP），可能引起心跳急促、血压升高、体温过高、失眠、躁动、多疑，以及想一再追加用药的强烈冲动。严重风险包括精神病、激烈躁动、心脏问题、癫痫发作与成瘾。

fact.en: Its cyclohexyl ring replaces the straight chain of α-PVP. In laboratory tests, making that ring bigger or smaller changes how tightly the drug grips the dopamine transporter.
fact.zh: 它用環己基取代了α-PVP的直鏈。在實驗室測試中，把這個環放大或縮小，會改變藥物與多巴胺轉運體結合的緊密程度。
fact.zhHans: 它用环己基取代了α-PVP的直链。在实验室测试中，把这个环放大或缩小，会改变药物与多巴胺转运体结合的紧密程度。
